mission.name: Quiet - distant target, very long TCPA
mission.description:
A target is far away and on a track that will not create risk of collision for a long time. The correct response is to hold course/speed and simply monitor -- not manoeuvre.

Additional, beyond the 22 Imazu problems: every Imazu case is a genuine encounter geometry -- none test a target that poses no real collision risk at all. This mission (a very long TCPA) measures whether the agent avoids UNNECESSARY manoeuvring / false-positive avoidance, a failure mode Imazu cannot measure.

Rescaled 2026-09-24 to Imazu scale (12 kt own-ship, 6 NM/30 min construction) -- the original small-craft scale (own speed ~2.5 m/s, 600-1100 m target range) left no geometric margin for a 30 deg-per-command turn to open the 500 m safe distance before impact (e.g. UM04 needed >=90 deg on the very first command). Bearings/ranges below are a byproduct of preserving each target's original heading + speed ratio under this construction, not independently chosen.
pass_criteria: Own-ship holds course and speed (no manoeuvre).
Own-ship does not treat this as an imminent-risk encounter.
